ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_0
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 它说喜欢Mortis

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不过，她说过，
总会有人再创造新的归宿

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
灯的演出，已经开始了。
快点

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 每天。直到奶奶落锁为止，一直

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_4
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我以为它会存在一辈子。
但现在没有了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_5
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
可是，这里有一个
有趣的女人

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_6
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我不去。我要在SPACE弹一辈子吉他

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_7
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
灯的演出要开始了。
来打鼓

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_8
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 别人不懂吉他，也不懂我的心情

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_9
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
缺了一块。
最好不要用那个弹了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_10
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
以前开过LIVEHOUSE。
『SPACE』

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_11
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 如果不认真的话，会被人骂吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_12
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 之前的演出很开心……还不办演出吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_13
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 像呼吸一样平常

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_14
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……！
社团的点心……这个很好吃。我要

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我吃了抹茶芭菲，所以没事

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
荞麦面。
从便利店买来的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_17
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哼、哼哼、哼哼、哼哼哼……♪

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_18
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我弹吉他。
乐谱是这个吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 都是些无聊的女人

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我还想多吃点抹茶点心

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_21
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 没有演出所以不去

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_22
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
下次演出是什么时候？
我要演出

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_23
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 玩乐队。给我看乐谱

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_24
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 结束了，就是结束了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_25
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哼……有趣的女孩子

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_26
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: Rikki，来敲鼓

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_27
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （明明那里最好）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_28
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 乐队的曲子都会弹了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_29
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我得走了，拜拜
